An '''automover''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]], with a simple circuit matrix. They could be found at [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] carrying out their preprogrammed tasks.<ref name="hsr">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref>
